faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to common queries
faq.q1: How do I book a cab?
faq.a1: You can book via WhatsApp, phone call, or through our website booking form. We're available 24/7.
faq.a2: Free cancellation up to 2 hours before pickup. Cancellations within 2 hours may incur charges.
faq.a3: Yes, all our drivers undergo thorough background verification and are professionally trained.
faq.q4: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a4: We accept cash, UPI, and bank transfers. Corporate clients can avail monthly billing.
faq.q5: Is there a minimum booking requirement for outstation?
faq.a5: Yes, outstation trips have a minimum billing of 250km per day.
